display.purpose: Hero headline only; italic + Electric Pink for the emphasized word.

body.purpose: Archivo working text; UI copy 13–15.5px, ledes up to 17.5px, 52–65ch measure.

label.purpose: IBM Plex Mono for filenames, formats, kickers (UPPERCASE +0.08em), dates, counts.

reading.purpose: Literata article body, 720px column, Body Warm color.

shadows.name: floating

shadows.name: studio-page

shadows.name: sheet

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: The one accent-filled action per view; hover lifts 1px with the pink glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF2E63; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 11px; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(255,46,99,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #17130E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filter pills; selected fills Electric Pink.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(23,19,14,.2); background: transparent; color: #17130E; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #FF2E63; color: #FF2E63; } .ds-chip--on, .ds-chip--on:hover { border-color: #FF2E63; background: #FF2E63; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF2E63; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Option groups (page size, margins, alignment); selected segment fills with Ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; border: 1px solid rgba(23,19,14,.22); border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; width: 320px; } .ds-seg__btn { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 6px; border: none; border-left: 1px solid rgba(23,19,14,.18); background: transparent; color: #17130E; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-seg__btn:first-child { border-left: none; } .ds-seg__btn--on { background: #17130E; color: #FAF7F2; font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg__btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF2E63; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Boolean settings; Electric Pink track when on.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-toggle { width: 46px; height: 27px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 2.5px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; background: rgba(23,19,14,.22); transition: background 0.18s; } .ds-toggle--on { background: #FF2E63; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-toggle__knob { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.25); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF2E63; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tool Card
components.description: The grid unit of the tool catalogue; hover lifts 2px and turns the border pink.
components.html: EPUB→PDFEPUB to PDFTurn a reflowable ebook into a fixed, printable PDF.
components.css: .ds-card-tool { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 260px; background: #FFFDF9; border: 1px solid rgba(23,19,14,.14); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 16px 14px; color: #17130E; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-card-tool:hover { border-color: #FF2E63; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF2E63; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-tool__badges { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #6E675D; } .ds-badge { background: rgba(23,19,14,.07); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-card-tool__arrow { color: #FF2E63; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-tool__name { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card-tool__desc { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: #6E675D; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields; pink focus outline per the Focus System.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 280px; padding: 11px 12px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #17130E; background: #FAF7F2; border: 1px solid rgba(23,19,14,.22); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6E675D; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF2E63; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Drop Zone
components.description: The file invitation: dashed border, serif headline, mono format list; drag-over turns it pink.
components.html:
Drop your EPUB here, or click to choose
.epub · up to 100 MB
components.css: .ds-dropzone { width: 420px; border: 2px dashed rgba(23,19,14,.3); background: #FFFDF9; border-radius: 12px; padding: 34px 16px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: #FF2E63; background: rgba(255,46,99,.05); transform: scale(1.01); } .ds-dropzone__headline { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #17130E; } .ds-dropzone__sub { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; color: #6E675D; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Filename Chip
components.description: Ink-filled mono chip that names the user's file wherever it travels.
components.css: .ds-filechip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; background: #17130E; color: #FAF7F2; padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 6px; }

narrative.overview: Every surface is a warm paper studio where books are re-set by hand. The desk canvas that book previews rest on, the re-typeset-line mark — three text bars, the middle one shorter and pink — the serif that speaks only in display sizes, the mono that annotates like a typesetter's margin notes: all of it belongs to one craftsperson's workspace. The system is warm, literate, precise, honest — bookish warmth carried by paper tones, typographic precision carried by exact spacing and hairline borders, and honesty carried by an interface that never decorates what it cannot do. Density is calm: generous fluid padding, one-column reading measures, grids that breathe. Expression concentrates in typography and in a single electric thread of pink; everything else stays quiet so the user's book — the actual object of the product — is the most vivid thing on the desk. The confirmed anti-reference is the generic converter-SaaS look: purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, emoji-studded feature grids, ad-slot clutter, and dark-pattern upload buttons.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-warm neutrals; one electric-pink accent used sparingly
Instrument Serif display voice over Archivo workhorse body
IBM Plex Mono for everything file-, format-, or data-shaped
Flat surfaces structured by 1px borders and paper→card background steps
Quiet precision, warm touch: small, exact interaction responses
A single 760px breakpoint; fluid clamp() everywhere between 390–1440

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: #FF2E63 is the only accent in the system and it is used sparingly — an arrow, a dot, a selected state, one CTA per view. If pink stops being rare, it stops meaning anything. New accent hues are prohibited.

rules.name: The Paper Step Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built by stepping Paper → Card and drawing a 1px border, never by tinting surfaces with hue or stacking shadows.

rules.name: The Serif Never Sets Body Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif exists only at display and heading sizes. It never sets a paragraph, a label, or a control.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: If it's a filename, a format, a size, a date, a count, or a kicker — it's Plex Mono. If it's prose — it never is.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a statement that something floats (book card, page preview, sheet, sticky bars) or responds (CTA hover glow) — never ambient decoration on resting cards.

dos: Do run the Focus System on every new interactive element (2px #FF2E63, correct offset, Ink-on-accent) — WCAG 2.1 AA is binding.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion (0.15s micro / 0.25s theme / 1s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) morphs are the tempo set).
Do use mono + uppercase + 0.08em for every kicker, and mono chips for every filename (Ink bg, Paper text, 6px radius).
Do keep touch targets ≥44px on mobile and reuse the 760px breakpoint — never introduce a second one.
Do draw illustration as re-typeset-line bar art or 1.6px stroke SVG, in-palette.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, gradients, glassmorphism, or colored surface tints — the converter-SaaS look is the confirmed anti-reference.
Don't put resting shadows on flat cards; borders carry structure (Flat-By-Default Rule).
Don't set body text in Instrument Serif, or prose in Plex Mono.
Don't use stock photography, emoji in UI, or icon fonts; imagery is generated brand art (OG pipeline) or inline SVG.
Don't fabricate visual proof — no invented logos, star ratings, testimonial avatars, or press badges anywhere (product commitment).
